budget.note: Research BLOCKED; no B sender. Real model sends 0; ledger keeps 0/24, 0 tokens, unknown price. Full costOf→settle chain preserves unknown and blocks; E only reserves.

stages.title: Fixed positives and original scopes
notes: The complete 0ede report and historical 595/a9b reports stay as measured positives; module/controlled/ordinary-installed/UI/recovery/native/value remain separate.

stages.title: Real opt-in HTTP success
notes: Both plain and narrow scope diagnostics require an actual HTTP 200 together with the bounded payload; 500/missing/201 or a stale payload is rejected on the recorded positive.

stages.title: Tuple, capability and consumer provenance
notes: Every required installed case binds subject and consumer package/file hashes read from the tar; capability facts come from package bytes and must agree across cases.

stages.title: First milestone complete gate
notes: The real 0ede positive, HTTP/status omissions and capability/schema/tuple/consumer controls are in the recorded set with exact codes and case attribution.

stages.title: Accurate 3b package
notes: Target is 3b2ff68/build470738fd33b22ff4/tar f04abb1b… with 0ede as the safety baseline; tuple, consumer files, schema/ABI and mode/operation come from the extracted package.

stages.title: D resource gate isolated
notes: D live cleanup scripts are not run until its fresh pre-signal/child identity/root gate is independently passed; only probe-owned resources are signalled.

stages.title: UI and readiness
notes: 3b contains the 4b console marker but the package entry predates GET /v1/readiness; both are recorded as NOT_REACHED rather than inferred.

stages.title: Second milestone user closure
notes: The package-consumer review flow is exercised end to end for reachable surfaces; unrecorded UI/readiness stay NOT_REACHED.

stages.title: A to C data driver
notes: The A producer manifest and C single driver are not admitted; the A→C two-snapshot chain stays NOT_REACHED while the package chain is measured.

stages.title: Two snapshot restores
notes: Default v1 and explicit v2 are created/verified over the same store and read by the package consumer; independent A→C restores stay NOT_REACHED.

stages.title: Install, reuse and upgrade
notes: Cold/reuse/no-executor/multi-state, 0ede→3b and 16→18, same-file REUSED, refusals with BLOCKED codes and unchanged PID, tamper and post-upgrade data.

stages.title: Third milestone required result
notes: The non-native ordinary/UI/readiness/recovery/install result is reported against the exact 3b tuple; full-product/native/value stay refused.

stages.title: Bounded stability
notes: Limited SSE/reconnect/reopen/concurrent readonly sequences return provider/queue/count baselines; no soak or global socket scans.

stages.title: H original observations
notes: H operational samples are inputs only; E validates source/tar/root/duration/redaction and rejects missing fields or cross-package samples.

stages.title: Trial materials and ownership
notes: Support material privacy and readiness wording are checked separately; defects go to owners without changing the required set.

stages.title: Fourth milestone final verdict
notes: wave25-status records the exact subject/consumer, the HTTP gate, the reachable user flow and explicit NOT_REACHED scopes.
